subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks expose only resetSession(reason?), or permanently support the unshipped explicit-session-key compatibility overload for external hook consumers?
rationale: The older arbitrary-key Plugin SDK PR closed unmerged, while this branch would promote its call shape into a public contract solely for deployed fork compatibility; repository policy cannot choose that long-term API obligation without owner intent.

options.title: Keep reason-only API
options.body: Expose only resetSession("new" | "reset") and require external fork consumers to migrate to the current-session-scoped contract.

options.title: Approve compatibility overload
options.body: Keep the explicit-key form only with owner approval, documentation, a named deprecation or removal plan, and tests proving cross-session rejection.

recommendation.title: Keep reason-only API
recommendation.body: Expose only resetSession("new" | "reset") and require external fork consumers to migrate to the current-session-scoped contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for the public plugin hook contract is commit 7f5a5a34.
